name: Maaya
source: Kei-kun's new mother. Although she knows the duties of a bride she didn't even have sex with her husband before he died leaving her a virgin. She insists that Kei-kun call her 'mother' though he too eagerly calls her 'Maaya-chan' due to her young age.
